name: Tallygator
author: tallygator

sections.description:
People now ask AI assistants to find and buy things for them. When an AI agent can’t read your shipping cost, gets stuck at your checkout, or is turned away by your bot protection, it leaves no trace: no abandoned cart, nothing in analytics. It just buys somewhere else.

Tallygator shops your store the way AI agents do and gives you a 0–100 Agent Readiness score, with plain-English steps to fix each problem.

Agent test purchase
An agent finds a product, picks a size or colour, adds it to the cart, gets shipping and checks payment, then stops. No order is ever placed.

What it checks

  • Can an agent reach your store: Cloudflare and other bot protection, security plugins, robots.txt rules for AI shopping agents, “coming soon” mode.
  • Can an agent understand your products: price, stock, shipping cost, return policy, barcode (GTIN/UPC/EAN) and brand in the product data agents read; shipping and returns written on product pages.
  • Can an agent buy: guest checkout, CAPTCHAs at checkout, pop-ups, shipping options, payment methods, HTTPS.

Automatic re-checks (daily, weekly or monthly, your choice) and a monthly email in plain English: your score, what changed, and what needs you.

Everything in this plugin is free. If you’d rather not make the fixes by hand, the separate Tallygator Pro plugin (sold at tallygator.com) applies the data fixes for you and keeps them on.

External services

This plugin does not connect to any external service. All checks are requests from your own server to your own store (its pages and the WooCommerce Store API).

The plugin shows links to tallygator.com (for example “Get Tallygator Pro”). They are plain links with no parameters and open only when you click them; no data about your store is sent. Tallygator’s terms: https://tallygator.com/terms and privacy policy: https://tallygator.com/privacy
sections.faq:
Does the test place orders?

No. It stops before payment and empties the test cart.

Does the plugin change my store?

No. It only reads your store and reports. It never changes products, settings or files.

Does it send my data anywhere?

No. The test runs from your own server against your own store. Nothing is sent to us.
sections.changelog:
0.3.3

  • New check: whether your store has a valid Poppy file (/.well-known/poppy.json) for Meta Muse.

0.3.2

  • Links to tallygator.com no longer include your store’s address.
  • Readme: added an External services section.

0.3.1

  • Choose how often the store is checked automatically: daily, weekly or monthly.
  • The score now never shows green when the agent could not reach the payment step (capped at 39, same rule as the Tallygator scanner).
  • Tested with WordPress 7.1.

0.3.0

  • Shows the new Tallygator Pro fixes (store details, product page tags) in the fix list.

0.2.0

  • Free plugin now reports only; automatic fixes moved to Tallygator Pro.
  • Automatic re-checks (daily, weekly or monthly) and a monthly email.

0.1.0

  • First release.
